user.title: Connect to Hup
user.description: Enter your Hup API key and select a camera to monitor.

data_description.api_key: Your external device API key from the Hup app (starts with hup_ext_).
data_description.device_id: The device ID for this camera in Hup (found in the Hup app under your external device settings).
data_description.camera_entity: The camera to capture snapshots from.
data_description.snapshot_interval: How often to capture and upload a snapshot (in minutes).

error.invalid_auth: Invalid API key. Check your key in the Hup app under Settings.
error.invalid_key_format: API key must start with hup_ext_.

abort.already_configured: This camera is already configured with Hup.
